notes.title: Update 1.0.6
notes.content:
[h1]A small update to fix the level status bug.[/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uk6cRYC.png[/img]

There are three level states:
[list]
[*] [b]Green:[/b] When the car reaches the end collecting all the items.
[*] [b]Yellow:[/b] When the car reaches the end and does not collect all the items.
[*] [b]Red:[/b] When the car has not reached the end of the stage.
[/list]

The bug made it impossible to get the yellow signal, confusing the player at times. This has been resolved, I hope you are enjoying the game. Your feedback is very important!

[u][i]Remember that in order to obtain the last achievement of the game, you must have a green light at all levels.[/i][/u]

Thanks,
Alysson Moraes - Developer.
